theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Choose light, dark, or follow the system appearance.

language.label: Language
language.description: Choose the display language, or follow the browser language automatically.

showBadgeCount.label: Show tab count badge
showBadgeCount.description: Display the number of open tabs on the toolbar icon.

confirmThreshold.label: Confirm before closing many tabs
confirmThreshold.description: Ask for confirmation when saving would close at least this many tabs. Set to 0 to disable.

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.description: Choose which tabs are saved and what happens after saving.

saveAllWindows.label: Save all windows
saveAllWindows.description: Include tabs from every browser window, not only the current one.

closeAfterSave.label: Close tabs after saving
closeAfterSave.description: Close saved tabs once the session is stored.

skipAudible.label: Skip tabs playing audio
skipAudible.description: Leave tabs that are currently playing sound open.

excludedDomains.label: Excluded domains
excludedDomains.description: Tabs from these domains are never saved or closed. One domain per line.

includeFileUrls.label: Include local file URLs
includeFileUrls.description: Allow saving tabs that point to files on this computer. Requires file access permission.

duplicates.label: Duplicates
duplicates.description: Control how repeated tabs and URLs are handled.

removeOnSave.label: Remove duplicate tabs
removeOnSave.description: Close repeated tabs and keep only one copy of each URL in the session.

matchMode.label: Duplicate matching
matchMode.description: How URLs are compared: exact, ignoring the hash fragment, or ignoring query parameters.

skipAlreadySaved.label: Skip already saved tabs
skipAlreadySaved.description: Do not save URLs that already exist in another session.

pinned.label: Pinned tabs
pinned.description: Decide whether pinned tabs are saved or restored.

skipOnSave.label: Skip pinned tabs when saving
skipOnSave.description: Leave pinned tabs open and out of new sessions.

restoreAsPinned.label: Restore pinned tabs as pinned
restoreAsPinned.description: Reopen saved pinned tabs as pinned when restoring a session.

open.label: Opening sessions
open.description: Configure what happens when you open the extension and sessions.

toolbarAction.label: Toolbar button action
toolbarAction.description: What happens when the toolbar icon is clicked: open the popup, save tabs immediately, or open the sessions page.

openSessionsAfterSave.label: Open sessions page after saving
openSessionsAfterSave.description: Show the saved session in the sessions page right after saving.

reuseSessionsTab.label: Reuse the sessions tab
reuseSessionsTab.description: Open sessions in an existing sessions tab instead of creating a new one.

urlDisplay.label: URL display
urlDisplay.description: Choose how saved tabs and sessions are shown.

mode.label: URL display mode
mode.description: Show saved tabs by title, by domain, or as the full URL.

showFavicons.label: Show favicons
showFavicons.description: Display each site's favicon in session lists.

showTabCount.label: Show tab count
showTabCount.description: Display how many tabs each session contains.

restore.label: Restoring
restore.description: Set how restored sessions open in your browser.

targetWindow.label: Restore target window
targetWindow.description: Open restored tabs in the current window or in a new window.

openInBackground.label: Open restored tabs in the background
openInBackground.description: Restore tabs without switching focus away from the current tab.

skipExisting.label: Skip tabs that are already open
skipExisting.description: Do not reopen URLs that are already open in the browser.

clipboard.label: Clipboard
clipboard.description: Choose the format used when copying tabs.

format.label: Copy format
format.description: Format used when copying session tabs: plain URLs, Markdown links, or titles with URLs.

contextMenu.label: Context menu
contextMenu.description: Choose which actions appear in the right-click menu.

enabled.label: Enable context menu items
enabled.description: Show SaveTabs actions in the browser context menu.

saveTab.label: Save current tab
saveTab.description: Add a context menu item that saves the current tab.

saveWindow.label: Save current window
saveWindow.description: Add a context menu item that saves every tab in the current window.

saveSelection.label: Save selected tabs
saveSelection.description: Add a context menu item that saves the selected tabs.

memory.label: Memory saver
memory.description: Free memory by discarding inactive tabs automatically.

autoDiscard.label: Automatically discard inactive tabs
autoDiscard.description: Free memory by discarding tabs that have been inactive for the timeout below.

timeoutMinutes.label: Inactivity timeout
timeoutMinutes.description: How many minutes a tab must be inactive before it can be discarded.

keepAudible.label: Keep tabs playing audio
keepAudible.description: Never discard tabs that are playing sound.

shortcuts.label: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: View the keyboard shortcuts assigned to SaveTabs.
shortcuts.instructions: To change a shortcut, open the shortcuts page below and edit the shortcut for SaveTabs.

commandLabel.save-tabs: Save all tabs in the current window

incognito.label: Incognito
incognito.description: Control how private windows are handled.

includeInSaveAll.label: Include incognito windows
includeInSaveAll.description: Include private windows when saving all windows. Requires incognito access permission.

incognito.deniedNote: This setting is disabled because SaveTabs is not allowed in incognito windows.
incognito.enableInstructions: To allow access, open the extensions page below, open the SaveTabs details, and allow the extension in private windows.

sync.label: Sync
sync.description: Back up and restore sessions with end-to-end encryption.

enabled.label: Enable end-to-end encrypted sync
enabled.description: Back up sessions to your sync account with end-to-end encryption.

autoUpload.label: Automatically upload changes
autoUpload.description: Upload new and changed sessions automatically.

autoDownload.label: Automatically download changes
autoDownload.description: Download and merge sessions saved on other devices automatically.

sync.keyMaskedHint: The key stays hidden because it is the only credential for your encrypted data.
sync.invalidKey: That is not a valid SaveTabs key.
sync.importPrompt: Upload local sessions under this new key?
sync.importPromptHint: Recommended. Local sessions will be encrypted and uploaded with the new key.
sync.importSuccess: Key imported. Local sessions will be uploaded under it.
sync.importSkipped: Key imported. Local sessions will not be uploaded.
sync.rotateWarning: Rotating creates a new key. Cloud data encrypted with the old key becomes unreadable and cannot be recovered.
sync.rotateSuccess: New key created. Local sessions will be uploaded under it.
sync.loseKeyWarning: If you lose this key, your synced data cannot be recovered.
sync.onlyCredentialWarning: This key is the only credential for your synced data. Anyone with it can read, change, or delete that data.
sync.statusOff: Sync is off. Cloud data is kept until you delete it.
sync.syncErrorsTitle: Some items could not be synced:
sync.authError: The sync key was rejected or the cloud data cannot be decrypted. Re-import or rotate your key.
sync.deleteCloudMessage: This deletes every synced session stored on the server for this key, then turns sync off so your local sessions are not uploaded again. Local sessions stay on this device. This cannot be undone.
sync.deleteCloudSuccess: Cloud data deleted. Sync was turned off so local sessions are not uploaded again. You can re-enable sync later.
sync.enableConfirmMessage: Make sure you saved your sync key. It is the only way to recover synced data. You can reveal and copy it in the Sync section.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: Import, export, reset and maintenance actions.
advanced.storageNearLimit: Local storage is almost full. Export or delete sessions to free space.
advanced.sessionsPlaintextWarning: Session exports contain plaintext titles and URLs. Store the file somewhere private.
advanced.importSessionsPartial: Imported {added} sessions and updated {updated}. Some sessions could not be saved:
advanced.resetMessage: All settings return to their defaults. Saved sessions are not affected.
advanced.clearMessage: All sessions saved on this device will be deleted permanently. Export a backup first if you need one.

options.memoryUnsupported: Tab discarding is not available in this browser.

validation.numberRange: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
validation.maxItems: You can add at most {count} items.
validation.duplicateEntry: This entry is already in the list.
validation.emptyEntry: Enter a value before adding it.

contextMenu.saveWindow: Save all tabs in this window

popup.loadFailed: Could not load the popup data.

sessions.title: Saved sessions
sessions.invalidResponse: The extension returned an unexpected response.
sessions.empty: No sessions yet. Save your open tabs with the Save window button.
sessions.deleteMessage: This session will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
sessions.loadFailed: Could not load the saved sessions.
